info.title: AIHW MyHospitals Universal API
info.description: Access current Australian hospital data from the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare MyHospitals Data API, including measures, reported measures, datasets, reporting units, and flat data extracts.

get.description: Retrieves a dataset from AIHW MyHospitals.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: datasetId
parameters.description: The dataset id.

schema.description: The dataset id.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

result.description: Dataset result object returned by the AIHW API.

version_information.description: AIHW API and data version metadata.
